title: NFL Week 8 Betting Preview & Best Bets: Picks For EVERY GAME!
transcript_summary: In this Week 8 NFL betting preview on The Action Network Podcast, Stuckey, Doug Kezirian, and Evan Abrams analyze key matchups, trends, and betting lines. They detail their Six Pack of favorite ATS spread picks, a Moneyline Underdog Parlay, and a two-team Teaser of the Week.

speaker_segments.speaker: unknown_1
speaker_segments.text: Intro montage and show branding for The Action Network Podcast.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Welcome degenerates to The Action Network Podcast NFL Week 8 betting preview presented by DraftKings with Stuckey, Doug Kezirian, and Evan Abrams.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Glad to be back after a tough week. Last week crystallized situational spots across college and pro football.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Let's get right into Week 8 after a quick word from DraftKings.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: DraftKings promo segment for new customers using code ACTIONNETWORK.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Overview of Action Pro line move alerts for tracking target line shifts.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: First, let's talk Thursday Night Football: Panthers at Packers (-3.5, O/U 47.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Panthers trends are interesting. They are awful as favorites but have covered 13 straight off a loss.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Leaning under 47.5 due to both defenses stopping explosive passing plays, offensive line injuries, and kicking concerns.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Matt LaFleur and Jordan Love are 36-21-1 to the first half under over the last four seasons.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Moving to Sunday Night Football: Eagles at Commanders (-5.5, O/U 40.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Taking Washington -5.5. Philly looks done after five straight losses and locker room issues.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Eagles defense is in complete breakdown. Washington's run defense has been solid under Flores' scheme.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Eagles are 0-7 ATS in second halves this season. Sirianni is 1-10 SU as a underdog of 3+ points.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Doug locks in Washington -5.5. Moving to Falcons at Buccaneers (-2.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: I'm picking Buccaneers -2.5 at home. Tampa's defense is top 5 DVOA against run and pass.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Atlanta's run defense is a paper tiger and benefited from +4 turnover differential last week.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Penix gets the ball out in 2.48 seconds, 50% under 2.5s, countering Bowles' blitz.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Tampa's defense can take away Penix's first read. Falcons games consistently land on 1 or 2 point margins.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Next up: Chiefs at Broncos (+1.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Taking Broncos +1.5. In 5 starts vs Vance Joseph's Denver defense, Mahomes has been in the bottom half in passer rating.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: I agree with Denver +1.5. KC's offense relies heavily on Kenneth Walker, and Denver's defense brings relentless pressure.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Kicking concerns with Harrison Butker. Running back committee situation with Jonah Coleman and Dobbins.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: KC's defense has matchup advantages, but Denver's motivation after opening night blowout makes +1.5 prime value.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Marquee matchup of the week: Ravens at Bills (-3.5, O/U 50.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Taking Ravens +3.5. Lamar Jackson is #1 in adjusted EPA/play and #2 in success rate when healthy.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Lamar is 13-2 ATS as an underdog, covering by 9.0 points per game. Bills defense is ranking near the bottom in every category.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Baltimore's second half drop-offs (+65 1H vs -70 2H) offer 1st half value opportunities.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Discussing first half spread vs full game line and Bills coin-flip decision to receive kickoff.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Bills 4th quarter games are 6-0 to the over. Josh Allen is 5-14 ATS in 1st halves as a favorite.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Locking in Ravens +3.5 as my pick.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Monday Night Football: Bears at Seahawks (-3, O/U 46.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Taking Seahawks -3. Mike Macdonald's defense shut down Payton and Reid offenses recently.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Caleb Williams is playing in-structure under Ben Johnson, leading NFL in CPOE and completion percentage.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Ben Johnson is 18-4-1 ATS in primetime and 14-2-1 ATS vs non-division opponents outside the NFC North.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Raiders at Jets (-1.5, O/U 45.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Taking Jets -1.5. Jets getting healthy with Breece Hall, Braelon Allen, Malachi Corley, and Amari Cooper back.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Jets hold distinct statistical edges on both sides of the ball.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Raiders defense was humiliated last week; coaching matchup heavily favors Las Vegas but spot is tough for travel.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Hurry Up Offense: Cardinals at Cowboys (O/U 54.5). Leaning Over 54.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Browns at Steelers (-3.5). Steelers have won 22 straight home regular season games against Cleveland.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Leaning Steelers -3.5 due to Browns road defense regression.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Colts at Jaguars (-9.5). Indy roster fire sale and secondary injuries make Jacksonville attractive.

speaker_segments.speaker: Evan Abrams
speaker_segments.text: Titans at Bengals (-10.5). Joe Burrow is 1-3 ATS as 10+ point favorite and 3-7 ATS as 7+ point favorite.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Patriots (-7) at Dolphins. Drake Maye is 12-4 ATS when favored by 3+ points against bad defenses.

speaker_segments.speaker: Doug Kezirian
speaker_segments.text: Moneyline Underdog Parlay leg 1: Vikings ML over Lions.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Moneyline Underdog Parlay leg 2: Chargers ML over Rams to pair with Vikings ML (~7-to-1).

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Teaser of the Week: Broncos +7.5 / Falcons +8.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Stuckey
speaker_segments.text: Summarizing 6-Pack ATS picks: WAS -5.5, SEA -3, TB -2.5, BAL +3.5, NYJ -1.5, DEN +1.5. Sign off.

extracted_picks.speaker: Doug Kezirian
extracted_picks.rationale: Philly is on a 5-game losing streak with locker room friction; Washington has the offensive capability to cover.

extracted_picks.speaker: Stuckey
extracted_picks.rationale: Tampa Bay defense ranks top 5 in DVOA against both run and pass, stopping Atlanta's rush-heavy attack.

extracted_picks.speaker: Evan Abrams
extracted_picks.rationale: Vance Joseph's defense has historically contained Mahomes below career averages in passer rating and success rate.

extracted_picks.speaker: Stuckey
extracted_picks.rationale: Lamar Jackson is 13-2 ATS as an underdog covering by 9 points per game; Buffalo's defense ranks near bottom in DVOA.

extracted_picks.speaker: Doug Kezirian
extracted_picks.rationale: Mike Macdonald's defense limits explosive plays at home, and Caleb Williams will face off-script pressure.

extracted_picks.speaker: Stuckey
extracted_picks.rationale: Jets offensive skill players returning to full health; Raiders defense in letdown travel spot after four straight losses.

extracted_picks.speaker: Doug Kezirian
extracted_picks.rationale: Leg 1 of Moneyline Underdog Parlay: Minnesota's offense ready to burst against Detroit's secondary.

extracted_picks.speaker: Stuckey
extracted_picks.rationale: Leg 2 of Moneyline Underdog Parlay: Chargers coming off a bye getting healthier while Rams accrue mounting injuries.

extracted_picks.speaker: Stuckey
extracted_picks.rationale: Leg 1 of 6-point Teaser of the Week, teasing Denver up from +1.5 through key numbers 3 and 7.

extracted_picks.speaker: Stuckey
extracted_picks.rationale: Leg 2 of 6-point Teaser of the Week, teasing Atlanta up from +2.5 through key numbers 3 and 7 in a low-scoring divisional game.

analysis_notes.summary: Matt LaFleur and Jordan Love are 36-21-1 to the first-half under over the past four seasons, showing slow early offensive starts.
analysis_notes.speaker: Evan Abrams
analysis_notes.quote: Love 9 and 1 first-half under at home since the start of last year.

analysis_notes.summary: Philadelphia is 0-7 ATS in second halves this season and Nick Sirianni is 1-10 SU as a underdog of 3+ points.
analysis_notes.speaker: Evan Abrams
analysis_notes.quote: The 0 and 7 second half is definitely something to look at with Philly.

analysis_notes.topic: Penix Quick Release vs Tampa Blitz
analysis_notes.summary: Michael Penix Jr. releases the ball in 2.48s with 50% of attempts thrown under 2.5s, countering Todd Bowles' blitz-heavy scheme.
analysis_notes.speaker: Doug Kezirian
analysis_notes.quote: Penix gets the ball out the fastest amount of time, 2.48 seconds.

analysis_notes.topic: Mahomes Efficiency vs Vance Joseph Defense
analysis_notes.summary: In 5 career starts against Vance Joseph's Denver defense, Mahomes has recorded bottom-half passer ratings and under 6.5 YPA in 3 of 5 games.
analysis_notes.speaker: Evan Abrams
analysis_notes.quote: His 5 starts versus this Peyton Vance Denver defense, they're all in the bottom half in passer rating for his career.

analysis_notes.summary: Lamar Jackson is 13-2 ATS as an underdog, winning 10 of 15 games outright and covering by an average of 9 points per game.
analysis_notes.speaker: Stuckey
analysis_notes.quote: Lamar as an underdog is 13 and 2 against the spread, covering by 9 points per game.

analysis_notes.summary: Ben Johnson is 18-4-1 ATS in primetime games and 14-2-1 ATS against non-NFC North opponents.
analysis_notes.speaker: Evan Abrams
analysis_notes.quote: With the Lions OC in here, 18-4-1 ATS in primetime.

analysis_notes.summary: Las Vegas travels across the country after four consecutive tough losses, creating a classic flat letdown spot.
analysis_notes.speaker: Stuckey
analysis_notes.quote: You're going across the country after four straight losses... this has flat written all over it.

analysis_notes.summary: Pittsburgh has won 22 straight home regular season games against Cleveland, including 9-0 SU in toss-up spreads (≤4 points).
analysis_notes.speaker: Evan Abrams
analysis_notes.quote: 22 straight... Steelers at home against the Browns in the regular season.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Doug Kezirian
quote_timestamps.quote: I think Washington is the side here. Philly... stick a fork in them.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Stuckey
quote_timestamps.quote: Let me throw out my favorite bet... let's go with the Bucks -2.5 at home against Atlanta.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Evan Abrams
quote_timestamps.quote: I'm going to go with Denver... taking a Denver team as a home underdog.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Stuckey
quote_timestamps.quote: I took the Ravens +3.5... Lamar as an underdog is 13 and 2 against the spread.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Doug Kezirian
quote_timestamps.quote: I like the Seahawks... at 3 I think I would have made this line like 4, 4.5.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Stuckey
quote_timestamps.quote: I played the Jets... their offense now should be finally fully healthy.
